messages:
kim_csm: Hey team — Novum (pilot) confirmed they need a regional proxy allowlist and a temporary rate window for next-week demos. They want eu-west-1 + ap-south-1 peering.

kim_csm: TL;DR from customer: sustained ~350 qps for 1h, short bursts ~1k qps for up to 5m. Auto-revoke after 72h. They care about stable latency for renewal decision. :eyes:

raj_ops: Copy. Do we have explicit IP/CIDR from them or are they asking for our peering?

kim_csm: They sent a list — pasted below. Also said demo will run from an AWS ELB.

kim_csm: ```
3.5.7.9/32
3.5.7.10/32
52.95.0.0/16  # ELB range (approx)
203.119.32.0/24
```

morgan_network: Good — we can add those to the allowlist. Two notes: 1) we should pin their route to the low-latency model profile for the demo to guarantee p95; 2) set a TTL/expiry on the allowlist entry (72h) so it auto-revokes.

raj_ops: I'll prepare a canary: add CIDRs to eu-west allowlist and open a temporary rate window on route `customer/novum/demo` with burst config. Canary to 10% traffic first.

raj_ops: Deploying change now...

deploy-bot: Deployment queued: route-update/customer-novum-demo -> canary 10% (eu-west-1). Change ID: du-2026-0331-77

deploy-bot: Deployment succeeded: canary live (10%).

morgan_network: Canary looks clean. No network errors on our side. I've pinned model profile `rl-low-latency-v2` on that route.

kim_csm: Customer notified and will start demo at 09:00 UTC tomorrow. They asked that we monitor token spend during burst and alert if cost > $X threshold. Can we add alerting?

raj_ops: Added alert: metric `route.tokens_per_min` with threshold > 150k tokens/min -> page on-call. Also set a quiet window for non-critical alerts during the demo.

taylor_se: I'll draft a short runbook for the demo (rollback steps, how to revoke allowlist early, who to ping). Sharing in #runbooks after lunch.

kim_csm: Perfect. Final asks from Novum: provenance header for requests, and a 72h auto-revoke. I added the headers note to the runbook. :white_check_mark:

raj_ops: I'll set the allowlist entry with expiry timestamp +72h and attach the change into the ticket. Ticket: CS-8921.

morgan_network: Also added dashboard tile: `novum.demo.latency` and `novum.demo.qps` to the pilot monitoring group.

kim_csm: Big picture — this demo being smooth removes a renewal risk. If stable, we can propose a Dedicated package during renewal. Please keep me posted on any anomalies.

raj_ops: Will do. Closing loop after 24h post-demo with metrics and customer feedback.

kim_csm: Thanks all, appreciate the quick turnaround. :pray:
